quiz.question: 「自由空氣基準」：若要檢查結果是否可信，哪一項提供本課的獨立驗證動作？
quiz.questionEn: Free-air reference basis: Which statement provides an independent verification action for judging whether the result is credible?
options: 用停產時流量與功率記錄交叉檢查，分清接收桶壓力變化及背景耗氣，不把單次超音波讀值直接當全年流量。
流量下降而電力不降可能是卸載功耗；先看控制狀態時間占比，不把它誤判為流量計壞掉。
合成洩漏0.30 m³/min、運行4000 h/年、平均比能耗0.11 kWh/m³，三者使用同一自由空氣基準。
optionsEn: Cross-check nonproduction flow and power, accounting for receiver pressure and background demand rather than annualizing one ultrasonic reading.
Falling flow without falling power may reflect unloaded consumption; inspect control-state fractions before blaming the meter.
Synthetic leak 0.30 m³/min,4000 h/year, specific energy 0.11 k Wh/m³, all on one free-air reference basis.
quiz.explanation: 本步要識別「獨立驗證方法」。用停產時流量與功率記錄交叉檢查，分清接收桶壓力變化及背景耗氣，不把單次超音波讀值直接當全年流量。 與本階段判準一起判讀：在相同參考空氣條件下把洩漏流量轉成耗能，分開平均比能耗與瞬時功率。
quiz.explanationEn: This step identifies independent verification. Cross-check nonproduction flow and power, accounting for receiver pressure and background demand rather than annualizing one ultrasonic reading. Interpret it with the investigation criterion: Convert leakage into energy on common reference-air conditions, distinguishing average specific energy from instantaneous power.

steps.title: 自由空氣基準 · 比較擾動與量測
steps.titleEn: Free-air reference basis · Compare perturbations and measurements
steps.objective: 完成「自由空氣基準」的比較擾動與量測，以本階段判據形成可複查成果。
steps.objectiveEn: Complete compare perturbations and measurements for Free-air reference basis and produce reviewable evidence against the investigation criterion.
steps.instruction:
用停產時流量與功率記錄交叉檢查，分清接收桶壓力變化及背景耗氣，不把單次超音波讀值直接當全年流量。
回到本階段實驗：在圖上區分標準體積、自由空氣與管內壓縮體積，為流量計寫清單位與基準。 Atlas Copco 的漏氣調查同時檢查流量與功率；本課以離線班次帳評估壓縮空氣損失。
把名義組與變更組並列，逐欄確認只改了預定條件；若需多變量，另開實驗編號。用同一單位檢查趨勢、偏差與判準：在相同參考空氣條件下把洩漏流量轉成耗能，分開平均比能耗與瞬時功率。
steps.instructionEn:
Cross-check nonproduction flow and power, accounting for receiver pressure and background demand rather than annualizing one ultrasonic reading.
Return to the investigation: Distinguish standard, free-air and compressed-line volumes; record meter units and reference conditions. Atlas Copco’s leak surveys examine flow and power; an offline shift ledger estimates compressed-air losses.
Compare nominal and changed runs column by column, confirming that only intended conditions changed. Give multi-variable experiments separate IDs. Check trend, bias, and criterion in common units: Convert leakage into energy on common reference-air conditions, distinguishing average specific energy from instantaneous power.
steps.observation: 對照組與變更組的差異能追到明確輸入或量測機制。用停產時流量與功率記錄交叉檢查，分清接收桶壓力變化及背景耗氣，不把單次超音波讀值直接當全年流量。
steps.observationEn: Differences between control and changed runs trace to explicit inputs or measurement mechanisms. Cross-check nonproduction flow and power, accounting for receiver pressure and background demand rather than annualizing one ultrasonic reading.
steps.failure: 同時變更多個輸入卻把結果歸因於單一因素。
steps.failureEn: Changing multiple inputs and attributing the output difference to a single factor.
steps.check: 在相同參考空氣條件下把洩漏流量轉成耗能，分開平均比能耗與瞬時功率。
steps.checkEn: Convert leakage into energy on common reference-air conditions, distinguishing average specific energy from instantaneous power.

quiz.question: 「自由空氣基準」：哪一項指出本課需保留的異常機制或替代解釋，不能直接當成驗收成功？
quiz.questionEn: Free-air reference basis: Which statement identifies an anomaly mechanism or competing explanation that cannot be treated as successful acceptance?
options: 交付參考條件、年度耗氣帳、控制狀態圖與修復前後比較計畫。
流量下降而電力不降可能是卸載功耗；先看控制狀態時間占比，不把它誤判為流量計壞掉。
optionsEn: Leak volume=72000 m³/year; estimated energy 7920 k Wh/year.
Deliver reference conditions, annual air ledger, control-state plot and before/after comparison plan.
Falling flow without falling power may reflect unloaded consumption; inspect control-state fractions before blaming the meter.
quiz.explanation: 本步要識別「故障與替代解釋」。流量下降而電力不降可能是卸載功耗；先看控制狀態時間占比，不把它誤判為流量計壞掉。 與本階段判準一起判讀：在相同參考空氣條件下把洩漏流量轉成耗能，分開平均比能耗與瞬時功率。
quiz.explanationEn: This step identifies fault and competing explanation. Falling flow without falling power may reflect unloaded consumption; inspect control-state fractions before blaming the meter. Interpret it with the investigation criterion: Convert leakage into energy on common reference-air conditions, distinguishing average specific energy from instantaneous power.

steps.title: 自由空氣基準 · 分辨異常成因
steps.titleEn: Free-air reference basis · Discriminate anomaly causes
steps.objective: 完成「自由空氣基準」的分辨異常成因，以本階段判據形成可複查成果。
steps.objectiveEn: Complete discriminate anomaly causes for Free-air reference basis and produce reviewable evidence against the investigation criterion.
steps.instruction:
流量下降而電力不降可能是卸載功耗；先看控制狀態時間占比，不把它誤判為流量計壞掉。
對照「自由空氣基準」的名義結果，分別建立物理故障與量測／紀錄偏移兩個解釋。指定一項能分辨它們的獨立觀察，再依證據選擇處置。把7920 kWh標成比例模型估算，修復後需在相同產量與壓力條件重測。
本階段必須重驗：在相同參考空氣條件下把洩漏流量轉成耗能，分開平均比能耗與瞬時功率。
steps.instructionEn:
Falling flow without falling power may reflect unloaded consumption; inspect control-state fractions before blaming the meter.
Against the nominal Free-air reference basis result, build competing physical-fault and sensing/logging-offset explanations. Name an independent observation that separates them and select the disposition from evidence. Label 7920 k Wh as a proportional-model estimate; remeasure after repair at comparable production and pressure.
Reverify this criterion: Convert leakage into energy on common reference-air conditions, distinguishing average specific energy from instantaneous power.
steps.observation: 證據能區分兩個成因；不足時明列待測量，不把猜測當結案。流量下降而電力不降可能是卸載功耗；先看控制狀態時間占比，不把它誤判為流量計壞掉。
steps.observationEn: Evidence separates causes; insufficient evidence remains an open measurement need. Falling flow without falling power may reflect unloaded consumption; inspect control-state fractions before blaming the meter.
steps.failure: 相同警報直接等同同一故障，沒有獨立觀察。
steps.failureEn: Equating the same alert with the same cause without an independent observation.
steps.check: 在相同參考空氣條件下把洩漏流量轉成耗能，分開平均比能耗與瞬時功率。
steps.checkEn: Convert leakage into energy on common reference-air conditions, distinguishing average specific energy from instantaneous power.

quiz.questionEn: Free-air reference basis: Which statement gives the evidence-based disposition or re-verification condition?
options: 若用實測平均比能耗e，洩漏能量E=q_leak te；此估算忽略卸載控制造成的非線性。
把7920 kWh標成比例模型估算，修復後需在相同產量與壓力條件重測。
Atlas Copco 的漏氣調查同時檢查流量與功率；本課以離線班次帳評估壓縮空氣損失。

Label 7920 k Wh as a proportional-model estimate; remeasure after repair at comparable production and pressure.

steps.title: 自由空氣基準 · 驗收並留下交接件
steps.titleEn: Free-air reference basis · Accept and hand over evidence
steps.objective: 完成「自由空氣基準」的驗收並留下交接件，以本階段判據形成可複查成果。
steps.objectiveEn: Complete accept and hand over evidence for Free-air reference basis and produce reviewable evidence against the investigation criterion.
steps.instruction:
交付參考條件、年度耗氣帳、控制狀態圖與修復前後比較計畫。
在交接件中加入「自由空氣基準」的原始資料、計算版本及下列驗收逐項結果：在相同參考空氣條件下把洩漏流量轉成耗能，分開平均比能耗與瞬時功率。
以本課決策條件作有條件結論：在相同參考空氣條件下把洩漏流量轉成耗能，分開平均比能耗與瞬時功率。 請接手者依同一輸入重作一項檢查，保留差異與未結案項。
steps.instructionEn:
Deliver reference conditions, annual air ledger, control-state plot and before/after comparison plan.
Include raw data, calculation revision, and each acceptance result for Free-air reference basis: Convert leakage into energy on common reference-air conditions, distinguishing average specific energy from instantaneous power.
Use the course decision condition for a conditional conclusion: Convert leakage into energy on common reference-air conditions, distinguishing average specific energy from instantaneous power. Ask the receiving role to repeat one check with the same inputs and retain discrepancies and open issues.
steps.observation: 接手者能從輸入重現驗收，且剩餘風險有負責人。在相同參考空氣條件下把洩漏流量轉成耗能，分開平均比能耗與瞬時功率。
steps.observationEn: A receiving role can reproduce acceptance from inputs and identify the owner of residual risks. Convert leakage into energy on common reference-air conditions, distinguishing average specific energy from instantaneous power.
steps.failure: 警報消失即宣稱通過，未按本階段判準重新驗證。
steps.failureEn: Declaring success when the alert clears without re-verifying the investigation criterion.
steps.check: 在相同參考空氣條件下把洩漏流量轉成耗能，分開平均比能耗與瞬時功率。
steps.checkEn: Convert leakage into energy on common reference-air conditions, distinguishing average specific energy from instantaneous power.
